_note: Online play, from the council's New Player Primer and the Discord. Times are US Pacific; the page converts them to the reader's time zone.

weeklies.name: Webcam Weekly
weeklies.blurb: Real cards (or proxies) on a real table, played over camera. The closest thing to sitting across from someone.

weeklies.name: Cockatrice Weekly
weeklies.blurb: Free client, every card ever printed, nothing to buy. The easiest way into a tournament if you don't own a paper deck yet.

leagues.note: The weekly's table, on your own time.

leagues.name: Cockatrice Async League
leagues.format: Four rounds of Swiss or a round robin, then Top 8.
leagues.note: Free to play from anywhere with a laptop.

leagues.name: MTGO Async League
leagues.format: Play five opponents of your choice, or a round robin, then Top 8.
leagues.note: For players who already own the cards online.

clients.name: SpellTable
clients.desc: Wizards' free browser table. Point a camera at your battlefield and play with paper cards or proxies.

clients.name: Convoke
clients.desc: A newer webcam platform with card recognition and an easy setup.

clients.name: Cockatrice
clients.desc: Open-source and free, with every card. The best way to test a list before you buy anything.

clients.desc: The official digital client, used for the MTGO league. Many Canlander staples are far cheaper here than in paper.
